what: Harvest time-tracking: long-time customers hit 5x–800%+ price jumps ($6k→$30k/yr; $12→$116.50/seat; $180→$2,145/mo). Mass 1-star Trustpilot wave Sep 2026, teams shopping alternatives.
why_us: Paying agencies/studios already budget for time tracking; switching cost is high but loyalty just broke. Simple, stable-priced Harvest clone or migration tool has immediate demand.

what: Warp.dev AI coding agent: users report $250 for a 2-hour run, $40 burned in 3 minutes, no prompt caching on BYOK, projects fail after credits gone. Same pattern on Lovable (lost projects, 1500 credits/$500 gone in seconds).
why_us: Repeatable 2026 pain: AI builder credit traps. Market wants predictable flat-fee or cached-token coding agents with refunds and project persistence.
revenue: users already paying $40–300+/mo; willing to switch

what: Pocket FM shipped Sherpa, fiction-writing AI trained on 100M+ hours listener retention. Claims $500M ARR (from ~$198–250M), 1200% content production lift, 10% of writers >$200k, one IP >$100M.
why_us: Proof that vertical AI on proprietary engagement data beats generic LLM wrappers. Template for niche writers/creators with owned distribution.

what: Secondhand X recap: Yasser Elsaid shipped pricing page + tweet, first customer in 30 min, $1M ARR in 117 days bootstrapped; called a GPT wrapper.
why_us: Shows distribution + paywall can outrun product sophistication for wrappers. Useful benchmark, not a build spec.
engagement: low on recap tweet; claim is circulating

what: Ask HN (5 days ago): privacy/security tools that don't exist — SDK phone-home inspector for your own apps, global registry of who stores your email/phone, default router DNS/VPN, anti-caller-ID spoofing.
why_us: HN audience pays for security. SDK leak scanner is a micro-SaaS for indie/mobile shops; data-broker tracker is consumer + B2B.

what: G2: QuickBooks Online plus hiked ~40% after lock-in; users call pricing predatory because migration cost > hike. Salesforce/Agentforce pricing pushes teams to Twilio Flex.
why_us: Classic incumbent tax. Room for lighter invoicing/AR tools and outcome-priced support agents.

what: Cited r/SaaS May 2026: 'I'd pay $200/month for something that finds 50 qualified leads a week and sends personalized cold email. Clay/Apollo/Instantly all need babysitting.' Invoice-to-QuickBooks agents also underserved vs chatbot wrappers.
why_us: Vertical agents (SDR, bookkeeping) have stated WTP; general chatbots oversupplied.

what: Website-to-native-app converters: 9.9k monthly searches, low competition, estimated $5k–15k MRR. SMBs still cannot ship iOS/Android from an existing site.
why_us: Recurring local-business pain, existing competitors thin (WebToApp.design). AI can compress build time.
